up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records with valid pChEMBL values for the human target CHEMBL2127 (Hepatic triacylglycerol lipase). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Filter for exact standard relation ('='), non-null pChEMBL values, and human organism (tax_id = 9606). Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ON a.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2127' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
